# E0340: a lens reads a field its source version does not declare

A mapping reads a field its source version does not declare. No instance of the
source has it, so the lens never has a value to copy.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		b: prev.nope
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	b: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0340]: v0.0 does not declare nope
 --> history/1.0.thema:7:6
  |
7 |         b: prev.nope
  |            ^^^^
  |

error[E0347]: v0.0 declares a and v1.0 does not, and nothing maps it
 --> history/1.0.thema:5:1
  |
5 | ForwardLens: (prev): {
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = help: write <field>: prev.a to move it, or a: _drop
```
